reports.title: Digi International Reports Fourth Fiscal Quarter and Full Year Fiscal 2026 Results

lines: Acquisitions remain a top capital priority for Digi as reflected by our definitive agreement, entered into on September 30, 2026, to acquire DT, a Norway-based provider of advanced sensing technology, for $130 million in cash, which we expect to fund using our existing revolving credit facility.
For fiscal 2027, we anticipate ARR growth of at least 15% versus fiscal 2026.
Revenue growth is expected to be 10-15% versus fiscal 2026.
Adjusted EBITDA growth is expected to be 12.5 - 17.5% versus fiscal 2026.
We expect it to generate $9 million in incremental adjusted EBITDA in our fiscal 2028 period.
